subject: status of the Poisson-truth corpus fit (scripts/h53_fit_truth.py)
does_not_replace: evidence/h53_fit.json, which is the output of the earlier *linear* simplex fit (scripts/h53_fit.py): rmse_first_order 0.09315, rmse_exact_closure 0.09620, max_abs_error 0.1577, target_n 249337.5 with 155466 saturated cells - a degenerate optimum, kept as evidence that the linear model class fails

attempts.outcome: random search reached best rmse=0.11579 after 101/570 log-uniform coefficient draws before the process was terminated; the objective never developed an interior optimum in N (monotone decrease with N, the signature of a field that cannot supply the required concentration)
terminated by the sandbox OOM killer at ~45 s (3 GB limit, 2 cores) with exit status reported only through the tee wrapper; no report written
started with --evals 60 --loo-evals 0, OOM-terminated at the first search print (rmse 0.12622 at draw 1); no report written

measured_field_signal.how_derived: for the 0.2778 file the closure requires T=5041 of N=12226 truth px, i.e. mean kernel coverage 0.41 of the fitted truth mass inside its 3-px halo; a field whose top 44k cells hit its halo 20.4% of the time against a 14.0% random baseline cannot produce that without inventing mass near the dots

known_cost_bug_for_the_next_session: predict() holds sup_list (24 full-grid boolean masks, ~295 MB) and halo_idx/halo_b (~300 MB of int64/float32) plus an 8 x 12.3M float32 basis stack (394 MB): build sup_idx inline and free the mask, or cache per-file functionals to /home/user/.arena/run, to get the peak under the 3 GB sandbox limit
decision: the fit is not needed to decide this week's slot: the emission is gated on an independent instrument (blocked SGMC-off holdout), and the shipped arm fails it. Re-running the fit is only worth the compute once the field itself beats the instrument, i.e. after training_features.tif is available again.
